notes: A written `הָיָה` takes the *have* itself under rule 43, leaving the possessive `לְ` `unrepresented` under rule 40 and the suffix the English subject pronoun.
The ASV writes *We ... all* rather than *all of us*, so no *of* falls to the suffix under rule 19's suffix-rectum sentence and `כֹּל` keeps its bare *all*.
